target.title: fix(mattermost): reject oversized websocket events
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where operators connected to a buggy or hostile self-hosted Mattermost server could have the monitor WebSocket client buffer an oversized event payload before the `ws` client rejected it.

## Why This Change Was Made

The Mattermost monitor now sets a 1 MiB inbound WebSocket payload cap on the default `ws` client. Mattermost WebSocket traffic is documented as JSON event envelopes, and normal post bodies are documented at up to 16,383 characters, so this keeps normal post/reaction events working while avoiding the upstream `ws` client default of 100 MiB for this monitor path.

Mattermost API docs: https://developers.mattermost.com/api-documentation/

Mattermost incoming webhook post limit docs: https://developers.mattermost.com/integrate/webhooks/incoming/

## User Impact

Mattermost users keep receiving normal channel activity, while runaway or hostile WebSocket frames fail fast with standard payload-too-large behavior instead of being buffered up to the much larger client default.

## Evidence

- `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs extensions/mattermost/src/mattermost/monitor-websocket.test.ts`: 11 tests passed.
- `pnpm exec oxfmt --check --threads=1 extensions/mattermost/src/mattermost/monitor-websocket.ts extensions/mattermost/src/mattermost/monitor-websocket.test.ts`: passed.
- `node scripts/run-oxlint.mjs --tsconfig tsconfig.json extensions/mattermost/src/mattermost/monitor-websocket.ts extensions/mattermost/src/mattermost/monitor-websocket.test.ts`: passed.
- `git diff --check origin/main..HEAD`: passed.

Loopback proof using `createMattermostConnectOnce()` with the production default socket factory:

```text
configured_max_payload_bytes=1048576
normal_frame_bytes=107
normal_event_received=yes
large_valid_frame_bytes=921677
large_valid_event_received=yes
oversized_frame_bytes=1048577
client_error=mattermost websocket error: RangeError: Max payload size exceeded
server_close_code=1009
received_posts=normal-post,large-post
```

AI-assisted: built with Codex
